name: Virginia Beach Spring 2023

venue.name: Great Neck Baptist Church
venue.address: 1020 General Jackson Drive Virginia Beach, VA 23454
venue.details: The competition will be held in the gymnasium which is located in the back of the church, signs will be posted.

information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VirginiaBeachSpring2023#25271-competitor-responsibilities) tab. COVID-19 SAFETY INFORMATION: Competitors should not attend the competition if experiencing symptoms of COVID-19, or if they were exposed to someone with COVID-19. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- This competition is supported by CubingUSA. ![](https://cubingusa.org/static/img/cubingUSA_4.svg)
